nextStep.eyebrow: Want a human to look at it?
nextStep.title: The Website Health Check
nextStep.text: The Beige-o-Meter is a quick, automated first look at one page. My Website Health Check is the opposite: I go through your website by hand, point by point, across 10 core areas, from SEO and AI visibility to messaging, calls to action and trust. You'll know exactly what's holding your site back, and what to fix first.

bio: I write website content, case studies and articles for service businesses that are brilliant at what they do, but whose words don't yet do them justice.

I've spent 30 years in marketing, including 10 in corporate life, before founding my own business in 2006. Today I work from Kerikeri in the Bay of Islands, with clients across New Zealand, Australia, the UK and the US.
A client once called me "the Swiss watch of marketing": precise, reliable and on time. I'm polite, but if something won't fly, I'll tell you. Nicely.
credentials: BSc (Hons) Management Studies · Postgraduate Diploma in Marketing (CIM)
